arabic text: GHURBAT MAIN QATL HO GAYA MAZLOOM BAY WATAN
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAIN (AS) HAS BEEN MASSACRED HEARTLESSLY, AWAY FROM HOME

arabic text: MAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN
english translation text: I WOULD SAY 'BROTHER,' AND THE BODY WOULD SAY 'SISTER.'

arabic text: TEERON PAY THA RAKHA HUA, LASHA HUSSAIN KA\nDOOBA HUA LAHOO MAIN, THA KURTA HUSSAIN KA
english translation text: THE BODY OF HUSSAIN LAY ON A BED OF ARROWS. THE SHIRT OF HUSSAIN WAS DRENCHED IN HIS BLOOD

arabic text: AWAAZ THI HUSSAIN KI BEHNA KAFAN KAFAN\nMAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN
english translation text: THE BODY WAS CRYING, 'SHROUD ME, SHROUD, ME'. I KEPT CRYING 'O MY BROTHER, O MY BROTHER', WHILE THE BODY CRIED 'O MY SISTER, O MY SISTER'

arabic text: AAYI NA RAAS DOO GARDHI, PARDES KI FIZA\nKUNBA SHAHEED HO GAYA, MERA GHAR UJJARGAYA
english translation text: THE STRANGE ENVIRONMENT DID NOT SUIT EVEN FOR A MOMENT. MY FAMILY WAS KILLED, WE WERE DESTROYED

arabic text: PARDES, DES GHAIR KA, APNA WATAN WATAN\nMAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN
english translation text: OTHER’S LAND IS STRANGE, OUR HOME IS HOME\nI KEPT CRYING 'O MY BROTHER, O MY BROTHER', WHILE THE BODY CRIED 'O MY SISTER, O MY SISTER'

arabic text: IK DIN KAY DAGH MAINAY, BAHATTAR UTHA LIYE\nKUCH DAGH MAINAY QALB KAY, ANDHAR CHUPA LIYE
english translation text: IN JUST ONE DAY, I WITNESSED 72 LOSSES\nI HAVE CONCEALED SOME OF THE SORROWS INSIDE MY HEART

arabic text: CHUPTAY NAHIN, CHUPA NAY SAY DAGH-E-RASAN RASAN\nMAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN
english translation text: HOWEVER, I AM UNABLE TO HIDE THE MARKS OF ROPES ON MY BODY. I KEPT CRYING 'O MY BROTHER, O MY BROTHER', WHILE THE BODY CRIED 'O MY SISTER, O MY SISTER'

arabic text: DEKHA HAY BABA MAINAY, JO MANZAR BATAOUN KIYA\nNAIZON PAY THA RAKHA HUA, SAR HAR SHAHEED KA
english translation text: O BABA, HOW CAN I RELAY TO YOU WHAT ALL I HAVE SEEN? THE HEAD OF ALL MARTYRS WERE RAISED ON SPEARS

arabic text: GHORON KAY DAWR NAY SAY THA TUKRAY BADAN BADAN\nMAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI THI LASHA BEHAN
english translation text: WITH THE TRAMPLING OF THE HOUSES, THE BODIES ARE IN PIECES. I KEPT CRYING 'O MY BROTHER, O MY BROTHER', WHILE THE BODY CRIED\n'O MY SISTER'

arabic text: QASIM KI LASH LAYE, THAY DAMAN MAIN SHAH-E-DEEN MAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN
english translation text: QASIM’S BODY HUSAYN CARRIED IN HIS LAP. I WOULD SAY 'BROTHER,' AND THE BODY WOULD SAY 'SISTER.'

arabic text: BABA HASSAN SAY TAABA HUSSAIN-E-SHAHEED TAK\nBABA AMEER-E-SHAAM SAY, DAUR-E-YAZEED TAK
english translation text: O FATHER, FROM HASAN TO HUSAIN’S TIME\nO FATHER, FROM MU‘AWIYA TO YAZID’S TIME

arabic text: MAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN\nLOOTA HAY AHL-E-SHAAM NAY BABA CHAMAN CHAMAN
english translation text: O FATHER, THE SYRIANS HAVE DESTROYED OUR ‘GARDEN’. I WOULD SAY 'BROTHER,' AND THE BODY WOULD SAY 'SISTER.'

arabic text: BARCHI KALAYJA-E-ALI AKBAR MAIN JAB LAGI\nBABA KO DI SADA KABHI AWAAZ MUJHKO DI
english translation text: WHEN THE SPEARHEAD PENETRATED AKBAR’S CHEST. HE CALLED HIS FATHER, & SOMETIMES CALLED ME

arabic text: KEHTA THA SEENA THAM KAY AMMA CHUBHAN CHUBHAN\nMAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN
english translation text: HAND ON THE CHEST, HE CRIED: MOTHER, ITS HURTING. I WOULD SAY 'BROTHER,' AND THE BODY WOULD SAY 'SISTER.'

arabic text: GHAZI KAY BAAD AUR QAYAMAT GUZARGAYI\nPYSAASON KI AAS TOOT KAY BAN MAIN BIKHARGAYI
english translation text: AFTER ABBAS’ DEATH, THE SKY FALL THROUGH\nSHATTERING THE HOPE OF THIRSTY ONES IN THE FIELDS

arabic text: IK SHAUR AL-ATASH KA BAPA THA DEHAN DEHAN, MAIN BHAI BHAI KEHTI THI THI LASHA BEHAN BEHAN
english translation text: EVERY MOUTH WAS SHOUTING AL-‘ATASH, O THIRST! O THIRST! I WOULD SAY 'BROTHER,' AND THE BODY WOULD SAY 'SISTER.'
